statement: Historical physical Puck notes now support fallback 0x40 six-byte mouse and 0x41 nine-byte keyboard reports coexisting with native 0x42 input. Exact Steam-alive host writes, watchdog seven-second expiry, transition timestamps, release mapping and client companion lifetime are still not physically measured.

applicability.scope: Evidence gap only; source and physical requirements described in docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md. Historical July 2026 operator-note ingestion narrows this open gap; original raw data withheld; physical promotion is not justified.
